actions.text: Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation. Ordered to be reported with an amendment in the nature of a substitute favorably.
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation. (text: CR S2173)

dimensions.assessment: Affects broadband grant recipients, subgrantees, and federal executive agencies processing communications use applications.
dimensions.evidence: tracks the progress of each eligible entity through major milestones under the Program

dimensions.assessment: Streamlines administrative oversight, tracking, and data controls for broadband permitting and grants.
dimensions.evidence: develop controls to ensure that data is sufficiently accurate and complete for an executive agency to track the processing time

dimensions.assessment: Involves administrative and tracking changes within existing federal grant frameworks rather than direct appropriations.
Amends multiple acts including the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act, the Middle Class Tax Relief and Job Creation Act of 2012, and the FAST Act.
dimensions.evidence: Section 60102(j) of the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act... is amended

dimensions.assessment: Imposes permanent reporting and data control requirements on executive agencies and federal programs.
dimensions.evidence: provide an annual report on the factors to-- (aa) the Committee on Commerce... of the Senate

missing_information: Specific figures on cost savings or administrative expenses required to implement the tracking tools.
importance_detail.rationale: Requires tracking dashboards and permit tools for Broadband Equity, Access, and Deployment Program grant recipients, improves federal communications application processing times, and adjusts NEPA review thresholds for certain broadband projects.
